items.title: Native Solana test-network acceptance (Block A)
items.blockedReason: Two waits. First, Gideon's re-review of the corrected command for the governance waiting-period rehearsal; no public step of that rehearsal happens before it. Second, the main 39-step flow waits for step 10, the first player withdrawal, which must run on 2026-11-03 at or after 13:11 UTC and before 15:37 UTC on the network's clock (the first-week Carried Interest rate). This clears when Gideon accepts the command and when that window opens. No activation of Internet Computer services or real rewards is part of this work.
items.nextAction: After Gideon's acceptance: run the rehearsal's read-only checks, then propose the reduction. In the November 3 window: run step 10, then steps 11 and 12.

items.title: Private board visibility and priorities
items.nextAction: Alden's priorities cutover is live (confirmed 2026-10-26). Later updates are event-driven: the priorities, cards, summary and glossary are refreshed together at each material checkpoint.

items.blockedReason: Needs a decision on claimant coverage, the original events and duplicate prevention, plus separate recovery authority. It clears only when that decision and authority exist.

items.blockedReason: All Internet Computer deployments and upgrades, activation, real reward minting, mainnet and the code merge are held. Each needs its own separate approval, considered after the test-network acceptance.
